title: Use the Map Monitor Message Panel to view AGV faults and locate a faulted AGV
summary: Use the Map Monitor Message Panel (right side of the Map Monitor screen) to view AGV faults via the “Drop down to show AGV faults” control, check “Count of AGVs disconnected,” inspect fault details, and then use “Locate Faulted AGV” to highlight/find the faulted AGV for further inspection.
when_to_use: When you need to identify which AGVs are faulted/disconnected and then locate the faulted AGV on the Map Monitor interface using the Map Monitor Message Panel controls.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Message Panel checks to identify faulted/disconnected AGVs and locate the faulted AGV for follow-on inspection.
access_or_tools_needed: Map Monitor Message Panel on the right side
Controls/fields shown on the panel: “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, “Locate Faulted AGV”

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Message Panel showing: “Count of active Robots”, “Count of Robots charging”, “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.

steps.title: Open Map Monitor and go to the right-side Map Monitor Message Panel
steps.purpose: Get to the UI area that contains the AGV fault dropdown, disconnected count, fault inspection, and locate control.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor screen and navigate to the right-side Map Monitor Message Panel.
steps.expected_result: The Map Monitor Message Panel is visible on the right side of the Map Monitor screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The panel shows the expected controls/fields including “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.
steps.failure_condition: The Map Monitor Message Panel is not visible or the expected controls/fields are not present.

actions.label: Verify panel visibility
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the right-side Map Monitor Message Panel.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide lists “Map Monitor Message Panel” on the right side with the AGV fault dropdown, disconnected count, inspection, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.

steps.title: Review overall robot activity counts
steps.purpose: Establish context for system activity while diagnosing AGV faults/disconnections.
steps.instruction: On the Map Monitor Message Panel, check “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.
steps.expected_result: You can see the numeric values for “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging” on the panel.
steps.healthy_condition: The panel displays both count metrics (no missing/blank metric labels).
steps.failure_condition: The count metrics are missing/blank or the panel does not display them.

actions.label: Read robot count metrics
actions.exact_action: Check “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.

steps.title: Open the AGV faults dropdown to view fault entries
steps.purpose: Identify which AGVs have active faults/disconnect-related entries.
steps.instruction: Use the control labeled “Drop down to show AGV faults” to display the list of AGV faults.
steps.expected_result: The AGV faults list expands and shows fault entries in the dropdown.
steps.healthy_condition: The dropdown displays one or more AGV fault entries when faults are expected to exist.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV faults dropdown does not show any fault entries while the system is expected to have faults.

actions.label: Expand AGV faults list
actions.exact_action: Use “Drop down to show AGV faults” to display the list of AGV faults.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV faults dropdown does not show any fault entries while the system is expected to have faults, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists “Drop down to show AGV faults” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.

steps.title: Check the disconnected AGV count
steps.purpose: Quantify how many AGVs are disconnected to support fault triage.
steps.instruction: Review “Count of AGVs disconnected” on the Map Monitor Message Panel.
steps.expected_result: You can see the numeric value for “Count of AGVs disconnected”.
steps.healthy_condition: The disconnected count field is populated and readable.
steps.failure_condition: The disconnected count field is missing/blank or not updating as expected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists “Count of AGVs disconnected” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.

steps.title: Inspect fault details for the selected AGV fault entry
steps.purpose: Obtain the fault details needed to determine which AGV requires attention.
steps.instruction: Use “Inspection to view details of fault” to view the fault details for the relevant AGV fault entry.
steps.expected_result: The fault details area updates to show details corresponding to the selected fault entry.
steps.healthy_condition: Fault details are displayed in the inspection/details area tied to the selected fault entry.
steps.failure_condition: Fault details do not appear or do not correspond to the selected fault entry.

actions.label: Open fault details
actions.exact_action: Use “Inspection to view details of fault” to view the fault details for the relevant AGV fault entry.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists “Inspection to view details of fault” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.

steps.title: Locate the faulted AGV on the map/interface
steps.purpose: Highlight/find the faulted AGV so it can be inspected further on the map/interface.
steps.instruction: Use “Locate Faulted AGV” to highlight/find the faulted AGV on the map/interface.
steps.expected_result: After using “Locate Faulted AGV”, the faulted AGV is identified/highlighted on the map/interface.
steps.healthy_condition: The locate action results in a visible highlight/identification of the faulted AGV corresponding to the selected fault.
steps.failure_condition: “Locate Faulted AGV” does not identify/highlight an AGV after selecting a fault.

actions.label: Locate faulted AGV
actions.exact_action: Use “Locate Faulted AGV” to highlight/find the faulted AGV on the map/interface.

stop_or_escalate_if: If “Locate Faulted AGV” does not identify/highlight an AGV after selecting a fault, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists “Locate Faulted AGV” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.

success_criteria: AGV faults are visible via the “Drop down to show AGV faults” control.
“Count of AGVs disconnected” is readable on the panel.
Fault details are viewable via “Inspection to view details of fault” for the relevant fault entry.
“Locate Faulted AGV” highlights/identifies the faulted AGV on the map/interface.
healthy_conditions: Map Monitor Message Panel shows the expected controls/fields: “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.
Fault dropdown contains entries when faults are expected.
Locate action results in a visible identification/highlight of the faulted AGV.
failure_conditions: AGV faults dropdown shows no fault entries while faults are expected.
Fault details do not display or do not correspond to the selected fault entry.
Locate Faulted AGV does not identify/highlight an AGV after selecting a fault.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV faults dropdown shows no fault entries while faults are expected, stop and escalate to support.
If “Locate Faulted AGV” does not identify/highlight an AGV after selecting a fault, stop and escalate to support.
